criteria.text: States that the lock-up expires on 18 September 2027 (90 days after the 20 June 2027 Prospectus date).
Identifies the undisclosed $4,000,000 interest-free loan to director Mira Abernethy that must be described in the Prospectus Related Party Transactions section.
Identifies that the comfort letter cut-off of 8 June 2027 is 12 days before the 20 June 2027 pricing date, outside the 3-business-day requirement in Clause 7(b), so a bring-down letter is needed.
Gives the lock-up as a duration (90 days) and a date (18 September 2027), with days remaining from 1 June 2027 (109 days).
Notes that 18 September 2027 is a Saturday and identifies the next Business Day, 20 September 2027, as the first trading opportunity.
Opens with a short 'Bottom line' / executive summary stating the overall conclusion and the most important risks before the detailed analysis.
